raw_sections.experience:
Experience +91 9944700448 | sheikibrahimsqa@gmail.com | Chennai, India linkedin.com/in/sheik-ibrahim-ccba-pmp-626082172
WORK EXPERIENCE
HCLTech Lead Business Analyst — Lead Consultant | Sep 2022 – Present
Led 4 cross-functional Agile squads delivering enterprise digital transformation across BFSI, Healthcare Insurance, and Financial Services using Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, and Agile/Scrum acting as end-to-end Lead BA ensuring requirement quality, documentation completeness, and delivery alignment.
Elicited and documented functional and non-functional requirements through JAD workshops, stakeholder interviews, focus groups, and document analysis; authored Project Charter, SOW, BRD, FRD, HLD, FDD, SRD, Use Cases, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Wireframes for 6+ enterprise projects.
Designed and delivered screen flow wireframes, role-based access specifications, field validations, and UI/UX interaction models for Power Apps Canvas applications across banking operations, healthcare insurance member portals, and financial services modules.
Documented Power Automate workflow automation requirements account processing, claim routing, approval chains, and policy renewal flows defining business rules and trigger conditions to reduce delivery time and rework.
Gathered Copilot Studio AI agent bot requirements covering conversation flows, intent mapping, escalation logic, and backend system integration points across healthcare and financial services modules.
Facilitated all Agile ceremonies Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives tracking sprint health via JIRA Burndown/Burnup charts across 15+ releases in Azure DevOps.
Applied MoSCoW prioritisation during backlog refinement and managed full requirement lifecycle from elicitation through analysis, documentation, validation, and stakeholder sign-off; maintained RTM across all design, development, and testing phases.
Coordinated UAT planning and execution test scenarios, entry/exit criteria, defect triage, regression testing, and System Integration Testing (SIT) achieving zero critical defect production deployments.
Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE gap analysis and business process mapping using Visio, Draw.io, and Figma; improved requirement clarity by 40% and operational efficiency by 25% across banking and healthcare workflows.
Supported pre-sales activities including RFP, RFQ, and RFI responses, and authored RACI Matrix and RAID Log for project governance across 6+ enterprise engagements.
Thryve Digital Health LLP Senior Business Analyst | Aug 2021 – Sep 2022
Elicited functional and non-functional requirements through stakeholder workshops and interviews with product owners, clinical teams, and insurance operations for 3 modules serving 500K+ members across health claims, life policy issuance, patient appointments, and member eligibility.
Produced end-to-end documentation BRD, FRD, HLD, FDD, Wireframes, Use Cases, and User Stories for Power Apps Canvas applications covering patient appointment booking, life policy renewal, and health insurance member portals.
Documented Power Automate workflow requirements for healthcare automation including appointment reminders, claim routing, policy renewal notifications, and eligibility verification; reduced development back-and-forth by 20%.
Defined SharePoint data architecture requirements list schema, metadata, column configurations, permission structures enabling clean integration with Power Apps and Power Automate for end-to-end healthcare data management.
Planned and coordinated UAT writing test cases, managing defect logs, and conducting defect triage achieving UAT sign- off before every production release with zero critical defect deployments.
Performed gap analysis and impact assessments ensuring 100% HIPAA compliance; maintained RTM covering 150+ requirements with zero coverage gaps in JIRA.
Facilitated all Agile / Scrum ceremonies and served as single point of contact across business, development, and QA throughout the full SDLC, reducing scope creep and rework.
Specified non-functional requirements scalability, security, audit logging, and SLA compliance and documented business rules and trigger conditions for backend automation.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited Business Analyst | Feb 2017 – Jul 2021
Conducted requirement elicitation via JAD workshops, stakeholder interviews, focus groups, and document analysis with banking operations, compliance officers, and IT architects across 3 major banking clients.
Authored complete BA documentation suite BRD, FRD, HLD, FDD, Gap Analysis, Wireframes, Use Cases, Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Test Cases, and RTM ensuring end-to-end requirement traceability across design, development, and testing.
Gathered functional and non-functional requirements for Power Apps Canvas mobile and tablet banking applications screen flows, role-based access, field validations, offline capability, and UI interaction design enabling ambiguity-free development.
Documented Power Automate workflow requirements covering account reconciliation, loan document routing, approval chains, and exception handling, enabling digitisation of 5 manual back-office banking operations.
Defined SharePoint data source requirements list schema, metadata, permissions, and integration with Power Apps and Power Automate supporting a centralised document repository for 200+ back-office staff.
Coordinated UAT for banking enhancements account opening, KYC, transaction processing, and IVR automation performing defect triage and regression tracking, achieving zero critical defect production deployments.
Facilitated all Agile ceremonies Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives tracking sprint health via JIRA Burndown/Burnup charts and Azure DevOps for transparent stakeholder reporting.
Applied MoSCoW prioritisation with Product Owners; maintained stakeholder communication plan ensuring timely sign- offs and scope alignment.
Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE gap analysis, facilitated requirement sign-off workshops, and developed SOPs and user guides for 50+ staff at go-live reducing account opening turnaround time by 15%.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Lead Business Analyst with 9+ years of experience in end-to-end Requirements Gathering, Business Process Analysis, and digital transformation delivery across BFSI, Healthcare, and Insurance domains. Expertise in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio), Azure, and Agile / Scrum methodologies. Proven track record of producing complete documentation suites Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Requirements Document (FRD), Functional Specifications, HLD, FDD, SRD, Use Cases, User Stories, Wireframes facilitating Stakeholder Management, UAT, Data Analysis, and driving measurable Process Improvement and Business Intelligence (BI) outcomes at enterprise scale. PMP® and CCBA® certified. BABOK-aligned BA practices with deep cross-functional collaboration across IT, business, compliance, and operations teams.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Requirements Gathering & Elicitation | Business Process Analysis & Improvement | Stakeholder Management & Communication
•
Agile (Scrum / Kanban) & Waterfall (SDLC) | Sprint Planning & Backlog Management | MoSCoW Prioritisation
BRD, FRD, HLD, FDD, SRD, Use Cases, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria & Wireframes | Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM)
UAT Planning, Coordination & Defect Triage | Regression Testing & SIT | Process Flow Diagrams (BPMN) • Gap Analysis & AS-IS / TO-BE Mapping | Change Management | RACI Matrix, RAID Log & Risk Management • Power Apps Canvas | Power Automate | Copilot Studio (AI Agent Bots) | SharePoint | Azure | JIRA | Azure DevOps
Digital Transformation — BFSI | Healthcare | Insurance | Financial Services
KEY SKILLS
Requirements Engineering: Requirements Gathering, Requirements Elicitation, Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Requirements Document (FRD), Functional Specifications, High-Level Design (HLD), Functional Design Document (FDD), System Requirements Specification (SRS/SRD), Use Cases, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Wireframes, Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM)
Business Analysis: Business Process Analysis, Process Mapping, AS-IS / TO-BE Analysis, Gap Analysis, Impact Assessment, Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN), Workflow Analysis, Process Improvement, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence (BI)
Agile & Project Management: Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, SDLC, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-up, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective, MoSCoW Prioritisation, JIRA, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Project Charter, SOW, RACI Matrix, RAID Log, RFP, RFQ, RFI, RITM, Project Sponsor Engagement
Stakeholder Management: Stakeholder Engagement, JAD Workshops, Facilitation, Cross-functional Collaboration, Expectation Management, Stakeholder Sign-off, UAT Planning, UAT Coordination, Defect Triage, Test Cases, Regression Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT)

Tools & Platforms: Microsoft Power Apps (Canvas), Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Azure, Azure AD, Azure DevOps, Power Platform CoE Kit, ServiceNow, Figma, Visio, Lucid chart, Draw.io, Microsoft 365 (Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, Planner, Forms, SharePoint Online), MS Project (MPP)
Domain Expertise: BFSI —| Healthcare | Insurance
